title: Dollar firm near 102 as the 10-year yield holds above 5.3%
summary: The Dollar Index held near 102.00 as the US 10-year yield recovered above 5.3%, around 24-year highs, ahead of a 10-year note auction. Danske Bank warned 10- and 30-year Treasuries risk hitting 6% on heavy supply.
ict: Note prices are falling (yields rising) while DXY rises, so they move in opposite directions: ICT calls that a trending environment. But yields are at a 24-year high while DXY is only near a 2-month high, so watch for a crack in correlation (SMT) before assuming the dollar trend continues.
